name: inspect_dart_aot
title: Inspect Dart AOT Snapshot
description: Inspect one ABI's Dart AOT snapshot inside an APK by pure parsing. The result preserves target and library identity, all four snapshot symbol sections and headers, snapshot hash candidates, and a bounded string-pool projection. String-pool entries are byte-pattern observations rather than deserialized Dart cluster semantics. No engine, target execution, or external lookup is performed.

path.description: Local APK file carrying a Flutter AOT payload

abi.description: Exact lib/ directory label; omitted selects arm64-v8a, x86_64, x86, armeabi-v7a, then remaining ABIs alphabetically

detail.description: Omit or use complete for the full retained observation; summary selects the identity and count projection

result.description: Evidence containing target, ABI, libapp snapshot facts, string_pool coverage and lower-bound counts, and producer limitations
